_why: Truncated SHA-256 of names that must never appear here: past clients, their products and programmes, and internal systems. These are hashed deliberately. This file is published, so a plaintext list would hand a reader the very names it exists to keep out, and the check would become the leak. A hash still matches and still cannot be read backwards.
_how: The scanner normalises each line to lowercase words and hashes every 1-, 2- and 3-word run. To add a term: node scripts/check-publishable.mjs --hash "some name", then paste the result here.
